_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Unacheza Klondike Solitaire. Lengo lako ni kusogeza kadini zote kwenda kwenye foundation.

Kanuni za Mchezo:
- Foundation (F1-F4): Jenga juu kutoka Ace hadi King kwa rangi
- Tableau (T1-T7): Jenga chini kwa rangi tofauti (nyekundu kwenye nyeusi, nyeusi kwenye nyekundu)
- Stock: Chora kadini kwenda kwenye waste
- Waste (W): Kadini ya juu inapatikana kwa ajili ya mchezo

Amri:
- 'draw' - Chora kadini kutoka stock kwenda waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Sogeza kadini kati ya makundi
  Mifano: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. Hesabu pia inaweza kuwa 'all', ambayo itajaribu kusogeza kadini zote zinazoonekana.
- 'forfeit' - Mwisho wa mchezo mara moja na kufunga alama yako ya sasa
- Majina ya makundi: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundation), T1-T7 (tableau)

Unaweza kutekeleza vitendo vingi kwa mzomo mmoja kwa kuyatenganisha na vígawanyiko:
  Mfano: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Wafalme pekee wanaweza kuwekwa kwenye makundi ya tableau yaliyo tupu.
Vitendo vinatekelezwa kwa mpangilio - ikiwa moja itashindika, vitendo vingine vinapuuzwa.
Tumia 'forfeit' ikiwa unafikiri mchezo hauwezi kushindwa.

format_error.no_brackets: Chinthu ichi chikwenera kuŵa pakati pa vikhwangwani.

outcome.forfeit: Mchezo ulifungwa. Alama ya mwisho: {score} kadini kwenye foundation.
outcome.won: Mwacita makora comene, mwathereska pa maseŵero gha Klondike!
